integrity: The proof derives component-wise equality of successor rows directly from the forcing condition and symmetry of the compatibility relation, then uses reflexivity of an equivalence accessibility relation to show that every compatibility component lies in one modal equivalence class. The converse construction from partitions is explicit. The predecessor author-accepted manuscript was read at the forcing definition and semantics, and the 2026 primary abstract was checked for component invariance and the equivalence-frame class. Exhaustive finite replay independently verifies the bijection.
scientific_limitations: The exact Bell count is for equivalence accessibility relations satisfying the quantum-modal forcing condition on a fixed finite orthoframe. It does not enumerate arbitrary forced relations, quotient by orthoframe automorphisms, or assert that distinct counted frames have distinct logics.
title: Bell census of forced equivalence modalities on finite quantum frames
